app.name: NovaCare Patient Appointments
app.short_description: View patient appointments from the Epic EHR system in the ticket sidebar.
app.long_description: Fetches and displays a patient's upcoming appointments from the mock Epic EHR API, using the ticket's Patient ID field. Lets agents add appointment details to the ticket as an internal note.
app.installation_instructions: Enter your mock Epic EHR API's base URL and API key, plus the numeric ID of your ticket's Patient ID custom field, then click Install.

api_base_url.label: API Base URL
api_base_url.helpText: Base URL of your deployed mock Epic EHR API (no trailing slash).

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.helpText: Bearer token for the mock Epic EHR API. Stored encrypted; only used inside client.request() templates, never readable from app JS.

patient_id_field_id.label: Patient ID Field ID
patient_id_field_id.helpText: Numeric ID of your 'Patient ID' ticket field (from Admin Center > Objects and rules > Tickets > Fields). Replace the default with your real field ID.
